class_data.name: Rage
class_data.notes:
You can imbue yourself with a primal power called Rage, granting extraordinary might and resilience. You can enter a Rage as a Bonus Action if you aren't wearing Heavy armor. You can enter your Rage a number of times equal to the Rages column of the Barbarian Features table. You regain one expended use when you finish a Short Rest and all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

While active, your Rage grants the following benefits:
Damage Resistance. You have Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage.
Rage Damage. When you make an attack using Strength with a weapon or an Unarmed Strike and deal damage, you add a bonus that increases as you gain levels.
Strength Advantage. You have Advantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws.
No Concentration or Spells. You cannot maintain Concentration or cast spells.

Duration. Rage lasts until the end of your next turn. It ends early if you don Heavy armor or become Incapacitated. On each subsequent turn, you may extend your Rage to the end of your next turn by making an attack roll against an enemy, forcing an enemy to make a saving throw, or taking a Bonus Action to extend your Rage. A Rage can last up to 10 minutes.

class_data.name: Unarmored Defense
class_data.notes: While you aren't wearing any armor, your base Armor Class equals 10 + your Dexterity modifier + your Constitution modifier. You can use a Shield and still gain this benefit.

class_data.name: Weapon Mastery
class_data.notes: You can use the mastery properties of two Simple or Martial Melee weapons of your choice. Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can change one of your chosen weapons. You gain additional mastery choices at higher Barbarian levels.

class_data.name: Danger Sense
class_data.notes: You have Advantage on Dexterity saving throws against effects you can see. You do not gain this benefit if you are Incapacitated.

class_data.name: Reckless Attack
class_data.notes: When you make your first attack on your turn, you can attack recklessly, granting Advantage on Strength-based attack rolls until the start of your next turn. Attack rolls against you have Advantage for the same duration.

class_data.name: Primal Knowledge
class_data.notes: You gain proficiency in one skill of your choice from the Barbarian’s level 1 skill list. In addition, while your Rage is active, you can use Strength for Acrobatics, Intimidation, Perception, Stealth, or Survival checks instead of their normal ability.

class_data.name: Ability Score Improvement
class_data.notes: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat for which you qualify.

class_data.name: Extra Attack
class_data.notes: You can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

class_data.name: Fast Movement
class_data.notes: Your Speed increases by 10 feet while you aren’t wearing Heavy armor.

class_data.name: Feral Instinct
class_data.notes: Your instincts are honed to a supernatural degree. You have Advantage on Initiative rolls.

class_data.name: Instinctive Pounce
class_data.notes: As part of the Bonus Action used to enter your Rage, you can move up to half your Speed.

subclass_data.name: Animal Speaker
subclass_data.notes: You can cast Beast Sense and Speak with Animals, but only as Rituals. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for these spells.

subclass_data.name: Rage of the Wilds
subclass_data.notes:
Whenever you activate your Rage, choose one primal option:

• **Bear** — While raging, you have Resistance to all damage types except Force, Necrotic, Psychic, and Radiant.
• **Eagle** — When you activate your Rage, you can take the Disengage and Dash actions as part of the same Bonus Action. While raging, you can take a Bonus Action to take both actions again.
• **Wolf** — While raging, your allies have Advantage on attack rolls against any enemy within 5 feet of you.

subclass_data.name: Aspect of the Wilds
subclass_data.notes:
Choose one option when you finish a Long Rest:

• **Owl** — Darkvision 60 ft. If you already have Darkvision, increase its range by 60 ft.
• **Panther** — You gain a Climb Speed equal to your Speed.
• **Salmon** — You gain a Swim Speed equal to your Speed.

effects.name: Giant Ancestry
effects.notes: You are descended from Giants. Choose one of the following benefits—a supernatural boon from your ancestry; you can use the chosen benefit a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest:

effects.name: Large Form
effects.notes: Starting at character level 5, you can change your size to Large as a Bonus Action if you're in a big enough space. This transformation lasts for 10 minutes or until you end it (no action required). For that duration, you have Advantage on Strength checks, and your Speed increases by 10 feet. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a Long Rest.

effects.name: Powerful Build
effects.notes: You have Advantage on any ability check you make to end the Grappled condition. You also count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity.

effects.name: Cloud's Jaunt
effects.notes: As a Bonus Action, you magically teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.

effects.name: Fire's Burn
effects.notes: When you hit a target with an attack roll and deal damage to it, you can also deal 1d10 Fire damage to that target.

effects.name: Frost's Chill
effects.notes: When you hit a target with an attack roll and deal damage to it, you can also deal 1d6 Cold damage to that target and reduce its Speed by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.

effects.name: Hill's Tumble
effects.notes: When you hit a Large or smaller creature with an attack roll and deal damage to it, you can give that target the Prone condition.

effects.name: Stone's Endurance
effects.notes: When you take damage, you can take a Reaction to roll 1d12. Add your Constitution modifier to the number rolled and reduce the damage by that total.

effects.name: Storm's Thunder
effects.notes: When you take damage from a creature within 60 feet of you, you can take a Reaction to deal 1d8 Thunder damage to that creature.
